title: A major proposal is never auto-accepted, even under the most permissive preset
rationale: explorer carries the highest ceiling the protocol defines, and it is still below major. There is no policy under which a major change may be applied without review, because autoAcceptCeiling cannot even represent the value.

requirement.text: Auto-acceptance applies only to proposals at or below the effective autoAcceptCeiling; acceptance above the ceiling without explicit review is a conformance violation.
